scale: Provisional ratings out of 10; higher is better

method.inputs: Pause-assisted synthetic keyboard, relative look and mouse inputs through existing playtest:visible driver; screenshots inspected between decisions. Not continuous human play.
method.information: Visible menu, Operator Handbook, first-person screenshots, HUD, facility map and terminal screens only. No source, tests, assets, prior reports or hidden state inspected.
method.limitations: Software WebGL fallback. No claims about hardware performance or human audio enjoyment. No successful finale, narrative records reading, dash, jump or capacitor discharge observed. No win/reset/discarded start.

attempts.coverage: Entry guard, west approach and triage, West Archive recovery, Heart guard and recovery, East Archive recovery, sprint return, uplink entry, upload, outside pause/decay and reentry, death screen.
attempts.finale: Reached uplink; screenshot showed 92% before terminal death. No completion behavior observed.
controlMistakes: Initial diagonal travel met low cover; sidestepped around it.
Held E while 4.0 m from West Archive and 3.4 m from Heart; MOVE CLOSER feedback prompted short adjustments.
A 450 ms left strafe exited uplink and caused decay; returned with a right strafe.
Final close-target fire missed; did not use available dash.

attempts.coverage: Entry guard, east lane and East Archive recovery, Heart guard and attempted receiver recovery, death screen.
controlMistakes: Turn toward an interceptor did not center it; wasted burst preserved.
First Heart burst missed to its left, then adjusted and eliminated guard.
Attempted Heart recovery at 3.7 m while multiple enemies remained alive; short left adjustment and E hold ended in death.
No dash used despite it remaining ready.

observations: Strong coherent rain-soaked cyan/amber art direction. Reflected warm lights, giant relay ring, bold title and readable terminal screen establish atmosphere.
Weapon, guards and cover have simple block-like geometry. The view is composed well, but asset and animation sophistication did not suggest a finished AAA presentation.

ADS visibly narrows view and centers the optic after a brief transition. Hit/critical elimination feedback and rapidly depleting magazine communicate firing consequences. Accurate optic adjustments could defeat guards quickly.
Facility map clearly separates walls and low cover and labels all three receivers and extraction. Markers, distances and signs enabled self-directed routing; the map freezes play as advertised.
Receiver prompts explained MOVE CLOSER and STEP INSIDE THE FLOOR RING when E was ineffective; all three recoveries worked after positioning adjustments in attempt 1.
Uplink UI clearly distinguished entry distance, near-edge warning, active upload, decay and reentry. Its narrow usable area punished my short strafe, making defense positioning demanding.

Multiple surrounding sources drained health rapidly while I stopped to aim or recover. Broad orange direction cues indicated danger but did not make exact attacker acquisition easy in these paused screenshots.
Small HUD text and numerous simultaneous markers/readouts compete with combat; the larger health, ammo, objectives and end-screen statistics remained easy to read.
Three recovered memories produced named cards and resource restoration. Their actual written stories were not opened, so narrative quality remains unassessed.

gameplay.rationale: Clear recover-and-extract loop, precise weakpoint opportunities and consequential positioning. Surrounding pressure was punishing and my stationary defense failed; control limitations and unused dash constrain difficulty judgment.
gameplay.coverage: Two deaths, all receiver recoveries and partial extraction defense; no win.

presentation.rationale: Cohesive atmospheric lighting, weather, typography and composition; simple geometry and restrained visual variety limit finish.
presentation.coverage: Menu, handbook, main facility routes, ADS, damage and death screens; audio unassessed.

usability.rationale: Visible controls, paused map, objective distances and explicit interaction/uplink feedback let me progress independently. Tight receiver and deck positioning needed corrections.
usability.coverage: Handbook, deploy/redeploy, pause, map, movement, fire/ADS, reload, sprint, recover and upload.

readability.rationale: Large HUD numbers, labels and amber optics read well; small low-contrast helper text and concurrent directional/marker information made precise threat interpretation harder.
readability.coverage: 1280x800 screenshots during entry, yard, triage and extraction combat.

aaaReadiness.rationale: A coherent playable slice with working loop and useful feedback, but observed geometry, enemy variety, visual feedback density and limited completed content do not support finished AAA readiness.
aaaReadiness.coverage: Provisional whole-slice impression from two ordinary attempts; successful finale, sound, hardware performance and long-term depth unassessed.
